current_state: All 48 released ADMIT rows have all seven gates strictly PASS; zero NA anywhere in admitted rows.

Only release_gate ever carries NA in current data: ordinals 132, 136, 152, 155, 157, 181; all are commit-only tiers; 132/136 are CONFIRM/MEDIUM, 152/155/157 are CONFIRM/HIGH, 181 is FALSE_POSITIVE; all are held/excluded, may_publish false.
No released-tier row currently carries any NA gate, so committed corpus counts and labels are unchanged and correct.
blocker: evaluate_publication_admission._closed_gate treats NA as closed, and released_publication_admitted strictly checks only release_gate == 'PASS'.
Synthetic probe: STRICT_RELEASED row, CONFIRM/HIGH, topology_gate=NA, release_gate=PASS, all other gates PASS -> may_publish true, ADMIT, no errors.

The fp211 leader contract requires that all required gates for the row's claimed scope close for CONFIRM and prohibits inferring PASS from absence of evidence; a released row with a non-release causal gate NA would violate the contract yet be admitted and labeled AI_CAUSAL by the builder.
Synthetic released row with release_gate=NA is correctly held (release_gate strictly PASS), so the gap is only in the six non-release gates.
recommendation: For released publication (publication_tier in RELEASED_SOURCE_TIERS), require all seven gates == 'PASS' in released_publication_admitted; keep NA-as-closed only for the CONFIRM-validity computation where NA legitimately marks out-of-scope gates on commit-only rows.
